text: For the director of music. A psalm of David. How long, O Lord? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
and every day have sorrow in my heart? How long will my enemy triumph over me?
Give light to my eyes, or I will sleep in death;
and my foes will rejoice when I fall.
my heart rejoices in your salvation.
for he has been good to me.
